THE LONG GALLERY

Audra waits behind the velvet rope in the Long Gallery. Next door in the Locked Studio, Corin is already moving across the floor to corner Pell before she slips away.

Loading the engine...

Watch another room

Press Watch studio (or V) to look into the Locked Studio while Audra remains in the Long Gallery. The watched frame reads the studio without moving the player scene, so clicks inside the watched view stay read-only.

Off-stage simulation

Every room runs on the same discrete clock even while off-screen. Corin's agenda walks across the Locked Studio from the Easel to catch Pell at the Corner regardless of which room you watch, and pressing R or clicking the timeline replays the pursuit from the same tick.

Walkthrough

  1. Restart if needed, then press Watch studio (V) right away to see Corin walk from the Easel to the Corner.
  2. Wait a moment as Corin intercepts Pell and marks her Found.
  3. Press V to return to Audra in the Long Gallery, or click the timeline to scrub back and watch it again.

Keys

  • V: toggle between Long Gallery and Locked Studio
  • S: play the next step for you
  • R: rewind to tick 0
  • Space: pause / resume
  • I: state inspector (both rooms' facts in one graph)
Runs entirely in your browser on the BeSpoke Engine, a simulation engine for systemic and narrative games. The whole game is in this one file; nothing is downloaded or tracked.
